title: home-spa in a box!
text: Overall, I'm very satisfied.  I absolutely adore the Birthday Cake rainbow swirl body butter, especially since it arrived right before my & my mom's bdays!! The natural ingredients of all of the products smell wonderful & are cruelty free & sustainable.  The only complaint I have was that the fizzy foot soak bombs arrived all broken & partially crushed up.... but it's not a big deal since I'll be using it for myself.... I love the mystery surprise element, it’s so much fun to unbox every month!!
label: positive
